messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content: Sure thing! To give you the most accurate list, could you let me know which Canadian province(s) or territory(ies) you’re interested in? Public holidays (and thus long weekends) vary across Canada, so knowing your target region will help me pull the correct dates.
message.reasoning: The user wants a list of long weekends for Canada in 2023. They want to fetch it. We can use the function to connect to a Bluetooth device? That doesn't help. There's no function to fetch data from an API. We might need to manually provide the answer. But we could also ask clarifying question: "Do you want the official public holidays?" Or "Which provinces?" Because Canada has different holidays per province. The user didn't specify province. So we should clarify. Also they want integration into their holiday planning app. We can provide a JSON format. But first we need clarification.
